description: This file sets up an AWS-based conversational bot with speech recognition, text-to-speech, and language model integration, including transport configuration, function registration, and event handling.

classes.description: Schema for defining callable functions with description, properties, and required fields.

classes.description: Schema for defining tools and functions available to the language model.
